en: Europe's fire problem: Researchers see the dawn of an era of “uncontrollable megafires”. Forest fires in southern Europe are becoming rarer - but when they break out, they are difficult to stop. The region is entering an era of extreme fire danger, according to a recent study.

de: Norden freut sich über Regen: NRW und Hessen erleben trockensten Juli seit 1881. Gelbe Wiesen, sinkende Pegelstände - die Folgen der Dürre sind besonders im Westen und Südwesten von Deutschland zu sehen. In Nordrhein-Westfalen und Hessen werden traurige Rekorde vermeldet. In anderen Bundesländern sieht es besser aus.

en: The north is happy about the rain: North Rhine-Westphalia and Hesse are experiencing their driest July since 1881. Yellow meadows, falling water levels - the consequences of the drought can be seen particularly in the west and southwest of Germany. Sad records are reported in North Rhine-Westphalia and Hesse. Things look better in other federal states.
